n0562fdaf2b.headline: South African rand firms after local mining data, US inflation print
n0562fdaf2b.summary: The rand firmed on Tuesday after better-than-expected local mining production figures and US data showing rising June inflation. It traded at 17.7775 against the dollar, 0.7% firmer than Monday's close.
n0562fdaf2b.why: The rand is South Africa's currency, and its moves reflect commodity exports such as gold and platinum, as well as global dollar and inflation trends.

impacts.name: South African rand
impacts.why: The rand gained against the dollar after stronger local mining output data and a rise in US inflation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n97d37c732e.headline: Australian, Chinese business leaders seek common ground
n97d37c732e.summary: A roundtable of Chinese and Australian business leaders in Beijing recommended greater collaboration on green steel and education. The recommendations were not detailed in the summary.
n97d37c732e.why: China and Australia are major trading partners, particularly in iron ore and other commodities, so bilateral business ties matter for trade flows.

nc9becb17ee.headline: Greece Records €4.667B Primary Surplus in H1 2025
nc9becb17ee.summary: Greece's state budget recorded a primary surplus of €4.667 billion in the first half of 2025, beating projections. The result is presented as evidence of strong fiscal discipline.
nc9becb17ee.why: A primary surplus excludes debt interest payments, and it signals the fiscal position that underpins investor confidence in Greek government bonds.

n0f38080bfe.headline: S&P Global downgrades Senegal’s rating over soaring debt levels
n0f38080bfe.summary: S&P Global cut Senegal's sovereign credit rating to B- and put it on negative outlook, effectively a further downgrade warning. The decision reflects concerns about soaring debt levels after an audit raised debt figures.
n0f38080bfe.why: Sovereign credit ratings affect the borrowing costs of governments and the pricing of their bonds for international investors.

n4e65dfee11.headline: Panama did not cede sovereignty to the US, foreign minister says
n4e65dfee11.summary: Panama's Foreign Minister Javier Martínez-Acha said US military exercises in the country are temporary and that no foreign armed forces will remain there permanently. He denied Panama ceded sovereignty to the US.
n4e65dfee11.why: The Panama Canal carries a large share of global maritime trade, so security arrangements in Panama matter for shipping and US-Panama relations.

n7901be0888.headline: Bessent no-show, Brics tensions set to cast shadow over Durban G20 meeting
n7901be0888.summary: Another no-show by US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Donald Trump's tariff threats and rising Washington-BRICS tensions are set to overshadow this week's G20 finance chiefs meeting.
n7901be0888.why: G20 finance meetings coordinate policy among the largest economies, and trade tensions between major blocs affect global growth and investor sentiment.

n2954499f79.headline: What MEPs and Parliament’s parties want from the EU budget
n2954499f79.summary: Each political group in the European Parliament is seeking to protect at least one flagship priority in the EU's long-term budget and is prepared to defend it firmly.
n2954499f79.why: The EU's multiannual budget sets long-term spending on agriculture, cohesion, research and defence, shaping public investment across the bloc.

na9d6f0f182.headline: Germany’s economic sentiment hits highest level since early 2022
na9d6f0f182.summary: The ZEW index rose to 52.7 in July, a three-year high, on hopes of a US-EU trade resolution and German stimulus. The eurozone outlook also improved, though markets stayed cautious after new US tariff threats.
na9d6f0f182.why: The ZEW index surveys financial analysts on the economic outlook for Germany and the eurozone, and is watched as a leading indicator for European markets.
na9d6f0f182.why_moved: Sentiment improved on hopes of a US-EU trade resolution and German stimulus, while new US tariff threats kept markets cautious.

n3e28bec88f.headline: T&G Global confirms sale process amid takeover interest
n3e28bec88f.summary: The New Zealand-based fresh produce exporter has engaged Craigs Investment Partners to assist with a potential sale after receiving numerous expressions of interest.
n3e28bec88f.why: T&G Global is a New Zealand fresh produce exporter, and a sale would change ownership of a major Pacific food supply business.

ne3f494024f.headline: China's GDP grows 5.3% in H1
ne3f494024f.summary: China's gross domestic product grew 5.3 percent year on year in the first half of 2025, according to data from the National Bureau of Statistics.
ne3f494024f.why: GDP growth is the broadest measure of China's economic health, closely watched for its impact on global commodity demand and trade.

nf31237725e.headline: Ghana must shift from raw commodity exports to value-driven growth – Dr Asiama
nf31237725e.summary: Governor Johnson Pandit Asiama called for Ghana to move beyond dependence on raw commodity exports toward value addition and service-led growth. He spoke at a Graphic Business and Stanbic Bank event.
nf31237725e.why: The Bank of Ghana is the central bank, and its policy direction influences the cedi, inflation and the outlook for export earnings.

ne2ebd1bbc2.headline: Too many Ghanaian businesses continue to price in US dollars - BoG Governor
ne2ebd1bbc2.summary: Bank of Ghana Governor Johnson Pandit Asiama expressed concern over the persistent use of foreign currencies, particularly the US dollar, in domestic trade.
ne2ebd1bbc2.why: Dollar pricing in domestic trade weakens the local currency's role and exposes the economy to exchange-rate pressure.

nce3e0429e3.headline: Mieten-Wertsicherung unter Druck: Regierung verspricht Lösung bis Herbst
nce3e0429e3.summary: The Austrian government has promised a solution for rent indexation by autumn, while the property industry calls for clarity following a Constitutional Court ruling.
nce3e0429e3.why: Rent indexation rules determine how landlords can adjust rents, which affects residential property returns and the real estate sector.

n26eb136eb0.headline: Czech mortgage market grows by nine percent in June
n26eb136eb0.summary: The Czech mortgage market grew by nine percent in June. The report gives no further detail in the available description.
n26eb136eb0.why: Mortgage lending growth is a key indicator of household credit demand and the health of the housing market and banks.

n3a57cec8cb.headline: Consumer win in card surcharge cut as business bristles
n3a57cec8cb.summary: Scrapping card surcharges could save Australians about $1.2 billion, while small businesses expect to absorb the cost. The change benefits consumers at the expense of merchants.
n3a57cec8cb.why: Card surcharges are fees merchants charge for card payments, so their removal affects retail margins and payment-network revenue.

nf084a2a248.headline: Why there's so much excitement around a cryptocurrency called stablecoin
nf084a2a248.summary: Stablecoins are designed to be a safer form of cryptocurrency, and Congress is preparing rules to govern them. The description gives no further detail on the proposal.
nf084a2a248.why: Stablecoins are crypto tokens pegged to currencies such as the dollar, and their regulation affects banks, payments and the crypto market.

n312dc8ee56.headline: BBC looking at licence fee overhaul as 300,000 households stop paying
n312dc8ee56.summary: BBC Director General Tim Davie faced questions as the corporation's annual report was published. The BBC is looking at a licence fee overhaul as 300,000 households stop paying.
n312dc8ee56.why: The BBC is funded mainly by the UK licence fee, so changes to collection or fee structure affect its revenue base and public broadcasting policy.

nef26458489.headline: Rejecting coins as a means of payment is illegal – BoG warns traders
nef26458489.summary: The Bank of Ghana urged traders and market operators to accept all legally issued coins, including small denominations of 1 to 50 pesewas. Reports of rejections have increased.
nef26458489.why: The central bank issues the national currency and sets rules on legal tender, so refusals of coins affect everyday payments and cash circulation.

n458075959b.headline: Savers to be targeted with offers to invest in shares under new plans
n458075959b.summary: Banks will send savers details of possible investments, and an advertising campaign will raise awareness, the Treasury says. The plans aim to encourage share ownership.
n458075959b.why: The UK government's retail investment policy affects how households allocate savings between cash and equities. Changes here can influence flows into UK-listed shares and fund providers.

n8c786f6e75.headline: Consumer win in card surcharge cut as business bristles
n8c786f6e75.summary: Scrapping card surcharges could save Australians about $1.2 billion, but small businesses expect to bear the cost. The article presents the move as a consumer win.
n8c786f6e75.why: Card surcharges are fees merchants add to card payments, and their removal affects payment revenue and retail pricing. Changes in this area influence the economics of merchants and card payment providers.

n22c6b07dfe.headline: Bad News for Terrorists: Lebanon Bans Banks From Dealing With Hezbollah 'Charitable Organization'
n22c6b07dfe.summary: Lebanon's central bank has barred financial institutions from any direct or indirect dealings with Al-Qard Al-Hassan, the financial arm of Hezbollah. The move was reported on Tuesday.
n22c6b07dfe.why: Central bank sanctions restrict which entities banks can serve, affecting compliance costs and correspondent relationships. Lebanon's banking sector is already under strain, so such measures carry financial consequences.

nd05b524b2e.headline: China hails PM's 'personal efforts' to restore ties
nd05b524b2e.summary: China's premier applauded Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's personal efforts to restore Chinese-Australian relations, which had reached a low point. The comments were reported in a short news item.
nd05b524b2e.why: China and Australia are major trading partners, and the state of their diplomatic relations affects trade in commodities such as iron ore, coal and agricultural goods.

naa971bbd3e.headline: Nigerian marketers reduce fuel prices as FG shuts down economy in honour of Buhari
naa971bbd3e.summary: Petroleum products marketers announced a reduction in premium motor spirit prices starting Tuesday. The move came as the federal government shut down the economy in honour of Buhari.
naa971bbd3e.why: Premium motor spirit is Nigeria's petrol grade, and its retail pump price affects inflation, transport costs and fuel subsidy policy in Africa's largest oil-producing economy.

n51c2cac248.headline: ADB urges 5% digital tax to boost e-commerce in Pakistan
n51c2cac248.summary: The Asian Development Bank has recommended a uniform 5% general sales tax on all digital transactions in Pakistan. The aim is to boost digital payments and e-commerce and reduce cash-heavy inefficiencies.
n51c2cac248.why: The Asian Development Bank is a multilateral lender whose policy advice can shape Pakistan's tax reforms and digital investment climate.

n603a6b3eb1.headline: Residential plots launch crosses 4.7 lakh in top cities, tier II drive boom: Report
n603a6b3eb1.summary: India's residential plot market has seen sharp growth in activity since 2022, with plotted developments in top and tier II cities attracting investors and developers.
n603a6b3eb1.why: Plotted developments are land-based real estate projects that let developers recognise cash flows faster than apartment projects. Trends here indicate demand in Indian real estate.

n0f783e2c2b.headline: Executive Centre is said to seek Rs 2,600 crore for India IPO
n0f783e2c2b.summary: The Executive Centre is planning an initial public offering in Mumbai that may raise 26 billion rupees ($303 million), people familiar with the matter said. The aim is to capitalise on demand for workspace in India.
n0f783e2c2b.why: An IPO shows how a company raises equity capital and tests investor appetite for its sector. Flexible office space is a growing segment of commercial real estate.

ne79cf1ad14.headline: Why Trump's U-Turn on Ukraine Matters
ne79cf1ad14.summary: A new plan would funnel billions of dollars into top-of-the-line weapons for Ukraine, according to a TIME column. The column describes it as Trump's most forceful backing of Ukraine yet.
ne79cf1ad14.why: US military aid to Ukraine affects the defence sector and the wider geopolitical outlook for Europe. Shifts in Washington's policy can influence energy and security markets.

n6f93bad994.headline: Nissan to end production at Japan’s Oppama factory by March 2028
n6f93bad994.summary: Nissan plans to stop production at its Oppama plant by March 2028 and the Shonan factory by March 2027, shifting work to Nissan Motor Kyushu under a global restructuring.
n6f93bad994.why: Nissan is a major Japanese automaker, and its plant closures are part of a wider effort to cut global manufacturing capacity.

n390ff4d89f.headline: Over 336,000 Pakistanis head abroad for jobs in first half of 2025
n390ff4d89f.summary: In the first half of 2025, 336,999 Pakistanis went abroad for work, according to the Bureau of Emigration and Overseas Employment. Most are heading to Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Qatar.
n390ff4d89f.why: Overseas labour migration is a major source of remittance income for Pakistan, supporting its foreign-exchange reserves and household consumption.

nf15663a362.headline: Greek Market Rises as Euro Strengthens - ATHSE Update
nf15663a362.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange posted modest gains on July 15, 2025, with the General Index at 1,964.41 amid broader European strength and a firmer euro.
nf15663a362.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market, and its index tracks the performance of Greek listed companies.

n6d1a246ab4.headline: Illinois clean energy hit hard by Trump’s ‘big, beautiful’ tax bill: ‘An incredibly damaging blow’
n6d1a246ab4.summary: Chicago solar installers report surging customer calls before a federal tax credit of about $8,000 expires, with one firm calling the bill an incredibly damaging blow.
n6d1a246ab4.why: Residential solar depends heavily on federal tax credits, so changes to those credits directly affect installer demand and project economics.

n96265aac34.headline: RBI launches quarterly industrial outlook survey
n96265aac34.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has started its quarterly Industrial Outlook Survey for manufacturing to gauge business sentiment. The 46th round of its Services and Infrastructure Outlook Survey has also launched.
n96265aac34.why: The Reserve Bank of India sets monetary policy and tracks business conditions to inform interest-rate decisions. Survey data on demand, prices and employment feed into its macroeconomic assessment.

n3389336387.headline: ADB report highlights weak digital growth, calls for urgent reforms
n3389336387.summary: The Asian Development Bank has released a report on Pakistan's digital ecosystem. It stresses the need for investment and reforms to improve connectivity and boost economic output.
n3389336387.why: The Asian Development Bank is a multilateral lender that funds infrastructure and reform programmes across Asia, and its assessments influence investment flows.

n8cb5460370.headline: ICICI Prudential Life's Q1 profit falls 21.8 pc sequentially, premium income drops 48 pc
n8cb5460370.summary: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance reported a sequential decline of nearly 21.8% in net profit for the quarter ended June 30. Premium income dropped 48%, according to the report.
n8cb5460370.why: ICICI Prudential Life is a major Indian private life insurer, and its premium and profit trends signal demand for insurance and savings products.

n6837ca5e09.headline: EU to target Boeing and bourbon for potential US tariffs in blow to Ireland
n6837ca5e09.summary: The European Union plans to target Boeing aircraft and American bourbon in potential tariffs against the US. The Irish government had tried to persuade the Commission not to target US whiskey and Boeing aircraft.
n6837ca5e09.why: Boeing is a major US aerospace manufacturer, and retaliatory tariffs on its aircraft would affect its export sales to Europe.

impacts.name: Boeing
impacts.why: Potential EU tariffs on Boeing aircraft would raise costs for exports into the European Union.

n63da267296.headline: Morning Bid: CPI, banks and Nvidia, oh my!
n63da267296.summary: Markets face new data on US inflation, bank earnings and Chinese growth this week, with a fresh update from chip giant Nvidia also expected.
n63da267296.why: Inflation data and bank results shape expectations for US interest rates and corporate earnings, which drive broad equity market moves.

n93d5fc83b0.headline: Stock market today: Dow slides after CPI inflation accelerates, Nvidia
n93d5fc83b0.summary: US stocks were led by tech on Tuesday as June consumer inflation accelerated and big banks kicked off earnings season. Nvidia was set to receive Trump administration approval for trade with China.
n93d5fc83b0.why: The Dow Jones Industrial Average is a price-weighted index of 30 large US companies. Nvidia is a leading maker of AI and data-center chips, so its China trade access matters for the semiconductor sector.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The article says Nvidia was set to receive a green light for trade with China from the Trump administration.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n93d5fc83b0.why_moved: The article ties the Dow's decline to a higher-than-expected inflation print, which raises the prospect of tighter monetary policy. Nvidia's China trade approval is a separate company-specific development.

nb3e0cdf091.headline: FX stable, stocks jump as markets assess US tariff developments, await inflation
nb3e0cdf091.summary: Most emerging market currencies held steady on Tuesday as investors awaited US inflation data. Stocks recovered on optimism over trade talks ahead of Trump's August 1 tariff deadline; Mexico was hit by a 17% tariff.
nb3e0cdf091.why: US tariff policy affects global trade flows and emerging market currencies and equities. Inflation data shapes expectations for US interest rates, which drive capital flows to emerging markets.
nb3e0cdf091.why_moved: Investors reacted to optimism that trading partners could negotiate ahead of the US tariff deadline, while awaiting US inflation data. Both factors affect emerging market risk sentiment.

n2072f6c259.headline: Ringgit strengthens against US dollar as China economic data boosts sentiment
n2072f6c259.summary: The ringgit closed higher against the US dollar on Tuesday as market sentiment improved on better-than-expected economic data from China.
n2072f6c259.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and China is one of Malaysia's largest trading partners. Currency moves affect the value of Malaysian exports and imports.
n2072f6c259.why_moved: Better-than-expected Chinese economic data improved market sentiment, which supported the ringgit against the US dollar.

n31229ca2e2.headline: Under Trump tariff pressure, ASML relies on TSMC while Intel and Samsung struggle
n31229ca2e2.summary: ASML will release its second-quarter 2025 earnings at 2 pm Taiwan time on July 16, one day before TSMC. Executives are concerned that TSMC order delays seen in the first quarter could recur.
n31229ca2e2.why: ASML is the Dutch maker of extreme ultraviolet lithography machines that chipmakers such as TSMC use to print advanced semiconductors. Its orders are a bellwether for the global chip equipment cycle.

impacts.name: ASML
impacts.why: The company's earnings release date and expected order conditions are the subject of the report.

impacts.name: TSMC
impacts.why: TSMC is a major ASML customer, and its order timing could affect ASML's results.

n17949bdce0.headline: European second-quarter corporate profits expected to fall 0.7%
n17949bdce0.summary: Latest earnings forecasts show European second-quarter corporate profits are expected to fall 0.7%. The outlook has deteriorated amid Trump's latest policy moves.
n17949bdce0.why: Aggregate European earnings estimates shape valuations of the region's equity indices and signal the health of its corporate sector.

n166696c686.headline: For Europe, 30 per cent U.S. tariff would hammer trade, force export model rethink
n166696c686.summary: A 30% US tariff on European goods, threatened by President Trump, would be a game-changer for Europe if implemented. It would force a rethink of the export model.
n166696c686.why: Tariffs on European goods affect exporters, industrial margins and the euro area's growth outlook, which matters for European equities and currencies.

na2e5291f10.headline: Carney casts doubt on Canada securing a tariff-free deal with Trump
na2e5291f10.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney signalled that most countries will likely accept some baseline US tariff rate on goods. He cast doubt on Canada securing a tariff-free deal.
na2e5291f10.why: Canada's economy is closely tied to US trade, so tariff levels directly affect its exporters, the Canadian dollar and related equities.

n0f51607a1c.headline: MIDF Amanah rebrands to MBSB Investment Bank
n0f51607a1c.summary: MBSB Group has rebranded MIDF Amanah Investment Bank as MBSB Investment Bank, effective July 10, 2025. The change is part of the group's wider transformation and unified branding strategy.
n0f51607a1c.why: MBSB Group is a Malaysian financial group, and its investment bank offers Islamic and corporate finance services. Group rebranding often precedes restructuring of its business lines.

nc8d6f3c735.headline: The Blockchain Group Raises €6 Million For Bitcoin Strategy, Purchases More Bitcoin
nc8d6f3c735.summary: The Blockchain Group raised €6 million, including €5 million from Adam Back, and added 29 BTC to its reserve. Total holdings now stand at 1,933 BTC.
nc8d6f3c735.why: Companies holding bitcoin on their balance sheets are exposed directly to bitcoin's price. Their share prices often track crypto market moves.

n3e5d216622.headline: PM wants fewer jobless foreign nationals on benefits as first-time data released
n3e5d216622.summary: The UK prime minister wants fewer foreign nationals on jobless benefits, as first-time data on universal credit claimants was released. The vast majority of claimants are British and Irish nationals or people without immigration restrictions.
n3e5d216622.why: Universal credit is the UK's main means-tested benefit, and welfare spending and labour-market participation affect public finances and policy debate.

n1bc979e1c6.headline: Sensex, Nifty open higher amid positive domestic cues
n1bc979e1c6.summary: Sensex and Nifty opened higher on Tuesday, supported by positive domestic cues including further softening of inflation. Asian markets were also largely positive in morning trade.
n1bc979e1c6.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark equity indices of India's stock market, tracking the country's largest listed companies.

n460cd71b2a.headline: Pakistan stocks set another record, surpass 137k barrier for first time
n460cd71b2a.summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange's KSE-100 index crossed the 137,000-point mark for the first time on Tuesday, setting another record. The index has been rising to new highs.
n460cd71b2a.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, tracking the largest listed companies in Pakistan's equity market.
n460cd71b2a.why_moved: The index set a fresh record by crossing 137,000 points for the first time, according to the report.

nd19c2740f0.headline: Thailand unexpectedly delays naming new central bank chief
nd19c2740f0.summary: Thailand unexpectedly delayed naming a new central bank chief. The 54-year-old Vitai is widely seen as a proxy candidate for the Ministry of Finance.
nd19c2740f0.why: The central bank sets Thailand's monetary policy and interest rates, so leadership changes can affect the baht, bond yields and perceptions of policy independence.

nd39f2e6df7.headline: Pakistan Stock Exchange smashes past 137,000 mark amid Record-Breaking Rally
nd39f2e6df7.summary: The benchmark KSE-100 Index surged past the 137,000 level for the first time in history as the Pakistan Stock Exchange extended its record-breaking rally.
nd39f2e6df7.why: The KSE-100 is Pakistan's benchmark equity index, tracking the largest companies listed on the Karachi exchange.
nd39f2e6df7.why_moved: The index extended a historic rally on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, pushing past 137,000 for the first time.

nc0d427adca.headline: Fidelity Now Metaplanet’s Top Shareholder With 12.9% Stake
nc0d427adca.summary: Fidelity bought a 12.9% stake in Metaplanet, becoming its largest shareholder. Metaplanet is growing its bitcoin holdings toward a 30,000 BTC goal.
nc0d427adca.why: Metaplanet is a Tokyo-listed company that holds bitcoin on its balance sheet, so its shareholder base and holdings link Japanese equity to crypto prices.

n981f2ef890.headline: US CPI, Japan Bond Crisis Triggers Crypto Market Volatility Today
n981f2ef890.summary: Crypto markets wobbled as US June CPI data and Japan's bond crisis sparked a Bitcoin dip and about $600 million in liquidations.
n981f2ef890.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency, and it often reacts to US inflation and interest-rate expectations and to broader global risk sentiment.
n981f2ef890.why_moved: US June inflation data and turmoil in Japan's bond market, per the report, prompted a Bitcoin dip and leveraged position liquidations.

ne8ab21e7a7.headline: Stubborn core inflation in June likely cements calls for Bank of Canada rate hold
ne8ab21e7a7.summary: Underlying inflation remained stubbornly high in June. Financial markets and many economists have firmed up calls for a third straight Bank of Canada rate hold this month.
ne8ab21e7a7.why: The Bank of Canada sets the policy interest rate that anchors borrowing costs and bond yields across the Canadian economy.

n0a777f5dc2.headline: ‘A tight spot’: Economists expect Bank of Canada to hold policy rates
n0a777f5dc2.summary: Canada's inflation rate edged up slightly in June. Economists predict the Bank of Canada will hold off on cutting interest rates this month, citing underlying price pressures.
n0a777f5dc2.why: The Bank of Canada sets the policy interest rate that anchors borrowing costs and bond yields across the Canadian economy.

n7be836d542.headline: Here's a list of June inflation rates for selected Canadian cities
n7be836d542.summary: Statistics Canada said the annual inflation rate was 1.9 per cent in June. The agency also released rates for major cities but cautioned about comparisons.
n7be836d542.why: Consumer price inflation drives Bank of Canada rate decisions and influences bond yields and the Canadian dollar.

n42fb051b82.headline: CREA cuts 2025 forecast again but says home sales are rebounding from ‘chaotic start’
n42fb051b82.summary: The Canadian Real Estate Association downgraded its 2025 home sales forecast. It said home sales are rebounding from a chaotic start to the year.
n42fb051b82.why: The Canadian Real Estate Association tracks national home sales, a key indicator for housing, mortgage lending and construction activity.

n02102a763c.headline: GTA home prices fell by 3 per cent last quarter. Here’s where they could be going next
n02102a763c.summary: Royal LePage said the aggregate price of a home in the Greater Toronto Area fell 3 per cent year over year in the second quarter of 2025. Buyers have taken a wait-and-see approach amid global economic uncertainty.
n02102a763c.why: Royal LePage is a major Canadian real estate brokerage, and GTA prices are a bellwether for Canada's largest housing market.

ne2ce97084d.headline: High inventory, falling rates creating ‘affordability window’ for homebuyers: CEO
ne2ce97084d.summary: Royal LePage's CEO said many Canadian real estate markets are seeing improved affordability. High inventory and falling rates are creating an affordability window for buyers.
ne2ce97084d.why: Royal LePage is a major Canadian real estate brokerage, and its commentary reflects conditions in residential property markets.

nd5e3f51bd8.headline: ‘A tight spot’: Economists expect Bank of Canada to hold policy rates
nd5e3f51bd8.summary: Canada's inflation rate edged up slightly in June, and economists predict the Bank of Canada will hold off on cutting interest rates this month. They cite continuing underlying price pressures.
nd5e3f51bd8.why: The Bank of Canada sets the country's overnight policy rate, which influences borrowing costs, the Canadian dollar and bond yields.

nbee8ee695d.headline: Carney says US-Canada trade deal likely to include some tariffs
nbee8ee695d.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney says a US-Canada trade deal is likely to include some tariffs. The two countries aim for an August 1 deal, even after Trump announced a new 35% tariff on Canadian imports last week.
nbee8ee695d.why: Tariffs on Canadian goods affect exporters, supply chains and the Canadian dollar, and the outcome of trade talks is a key driver of Canada's economic outlook.
nbee8ee695d.why_moved: A new 35% US tariff on Canadian imports was announced last week, and the two countries are aiming for a deal by August 1 that is likely to still include some tariffs.

n08fd0d9140.headline: Tariffs starting to show up at the store? New report shows inflation rise
n08fd0d9140.summary: US inflation rose 2.7% in June, up from May. The increase is a possible sign that tariffs are beginning to feed through to consumer prices.
n08fd0d9140.why: Inflation data shapes Federal Reserve policy expectations, which influence Treasury yields, the dollar and equity valuations.
n08fd0d9140.why_moved: June inflation rose 2.7% from May, a possible sign of tariff effects, which reduces the likelihood of near-term Federal Reserve rate cuts.

n9879ee2d34.headline: Inflation increase likely ends any chance of a Federal Reserve July rate cut
n9879ee2d34.summary: Analysts say the rise in inflation makes a Federal Reserve rate cut in July unlikely. They believe the tariff impact is just starting to show up in inflation figures.
n9879ee2d34.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, and its decisions affect borrowing costs, the dollar and asset valuations worldwide.
n9879ee2d34.why_moved: Inflation rose in June, and analysts believe tariff effects are starting to appear in price data, which removes the chance of a July Federal Reserve cut.
